batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b JO Holder

batting.name: JM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c R Parag b YS Chahal

batting.name: M Shahrukh Khan
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b JO Holder

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c MW Short b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c MW Short b NT Ellis

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c M Shahrukh Khan b NT Ellis

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: run out (M Shahrukh Khan, SM Curran)

balls.text: full and follows him outside leg stump, driven down the ground for a single to long-on.
yorker outside leg stump, jammed out back to Holder.

full in the slot slanted across eighth stump, Shahrukh goes to drive this over long-on but comes more off the toe. Buttler puts in another brilliant effort charging in from the rope 20 yards. The previous catch he took diving head first. This time he slides feet first to get his body under control and takes a knee height catch in front of his chest. Technically very different from his first approach, but equally flawless.
attempted yorker on leg stump, comes in as a shin high full toss at 129 kph and is flick/scooped over fine leg, one bounce over the rope.
135 kph yorker on leg stump, Shikhar shuffled across and reverse swats this through point off his toes for one.
thigh high full toss on fifth stump, flubs a pull through midwicket for one.
yorker at 138 kph on leg stump jammed out straight to midwicket for none.
yorker speared into the legs at 133 kph, inside edges this off the feet behind square leg for one.
slower bouncer on the stumps, pulled behind square for one.
low full toss at shin height going for a wide yorker, but Shikhar gets outside the line of off to spank this over extra cover, one bounce over the rope.
full toss at chest height sails way down the leg side and escapes Samson. They take another run and a no ball is called on height so Shikhar will get the free hit.
137 kph length ball on fifth stump, slapped on the up to Riyan Parag at mid-off who dives along the ring to save three runs.
length ball on fifth stump, Shikhar shuffles outside off stump again and scoops this high over deep fine leg, sharp catch taken by a Kings player moving outside the dugout.

Kings are reviewing an umpiring decision given as not a wide.  Shikhar shuffled way outside off, almost to the wide guideline outside off, to swat a thigh high full toss that was bowled off the pitch. It landed beyond the cut strip. This is an interesting call. It was technically within arms reach to play at considering Shikhar's position at time of delivery, but it landed so far off the cut strip that it is being given as a wide. So Shikhar wins the review with an assist from Shahrukh Khan at the non-striker's end who had a good angle to recommend.
full outside leg, flicked to deep backward square leg for one.
marvelous! Full on middle, Shikhar premeditates the reverse and flicks this over backward point just barely landing over the rope for six.
slower bouncer over fifth stump, Shikhar tries to reverse ramp this and misses.

goes for wide yorker again, sends down a knee high full toss slapped to extra cover. Picks out Hetmyer on the ring who flings a tight relay to Holder trying to deny the single. A direct hit would've been out but enough time passes with Holder collecting and trying to bring the ball back to the stumps to allow the single to happen safely.
wide yorker slanted across sixth stump, tries to jam this out but can't get bat on it.
full and follows him backing away from leg with a delivery speared into the legs, jammed out off an inside edge into the pads for one.
length ball on the stumps, slapped down the ground, tumbling stop on the rope saves two runs.
full outside leg, charges and heaves this off a very thin edge to short fine leg for one.
full on the legs, flicked to deep backward square leg for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes to reverse and miscues this tamely to short third for one.
length ball on the legs, flicked through wide backward square leg for one.
bullseye! Good length carrom ball darted in at 96 kph on off stump and skids away past a flat-footed poke to flick the outer half of off stump 3/4 of the way up.
full on fifth stump, Shikhar goes for another reverse sweep but misses off the pads and it dribbles to the keeper.
full on middle, flicked to long-on for one.

low full toss on fifth stump, charges and tries to slap this over long-off but it comes too low off the bat at ankle height and hangs up for an easy catch taken by Riyan Parag 10 yards in from the rope at chest height.
good length ball spins away past the wide guideline, left alone and wide called.
low full toss outside leg stump at ankle height, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
full on the wide guideline, Shikhar is determined to keep going for the reverse sweep and nails this high and deep over backward point, landing one bounce before going over the rope.
length ball on middle, goes to reverse this and picks out backward point for none.
yorker on leg stump, flicked to deep backward square leg for one.
length ball on fifth stump at 138 kph, hustled trying to pull and a thick leading edge goes over cover for one.
length ball on fourth stump, pulls this through wide long-on for two.

Extraordinary shot! Shot of the day hits the second tier facade over extra cover! Slower bouncer just inside the wide guideline, swatted inside out flat and somehow with enough timing to reach the second deck.
length ball on the legs, pulled behind square leg for one.
full on middle, driven in the air down the ground for one.
full and wide, slices a drive high over wide long-off to the rope.

close shave! Slogs a full ball from sixth stump high behind Chahal. Long-on won't be able to cover the ground so Chahal races back toward the edge of the circle and dives but it lands two yards out of his reach and they scamper two runs.

Back to back boundaries through the leg side brings up a 36-ball half-century. Full outside leg, heaves this in the gap perfectly between deep midwicket and deep square leg to the rope. 50 career IPL 50+ scores (48 50s and 2 100s). Only Kohli and Warner have more.
full on the stumps, sweeps this to deep backward square, timid effort on the rope to stop it and it slips past for four.
full on the stumps, driven down the ground for one.
full on fourth stump, shuffles across to try to scoop this wide of fine leg and it dribbles behind square for one.
length ball on fifth stump, miscues a heave through midwicket for two.
142 kph short ball down the leg side past a pull, wide called. Fumbled by Samson diving to his right so they take another run to put Sharma back on strike.
innovation from Shikhar! Good length ball on fourth stump, shuffles across and scoops this over fine leg to the rope.
full on off, shuffles well across his stumps to heave this to deep backward square leg for one.
full on fourth stump, goes to drive and scuffs this out to long-on for one.
full on eighth stump, driven to wide mid-off, diving stop on the ring keeps it to one.
full on off, jams this out back to the bowler.
Shikhar charges a good length ball on seventh stump, nowhere near the pitch but swings across the line at this anyway and launches it high over long-on landing in the fifth row.
full on middle, whips this down the ground to long-on for one.
this is even better than the previous one! Full on the wide guideline reaches out and flays this high over the ring to the extra cover rope, one bounce over for four.
full and wide, driven elegantly inside out through extra cover and beats wide long-off to the rope.
full on middle, charges and heaves this through wide long-on along the turf for one.
full on fifth stump, driven down the ground for one.
quicker ball speared in full on middle, punched back to Ashwin for none.
full on seventh stump, drags a drive down to long-on for one.
full on fifth stump, jammed out to Ashwin's right and he fields to deny a single.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through square leg for one.
full on the stumps, driven down the ground much less theatrically for one.

man down! Rajapaksa is nailed at the non-striker's end by a scorching drive from Shikhar.  Full on sixth stump, Shikhar heaves this flat and Rajapaksa can't get out of the way of this as it drills him in the right arm.
116 kph slower length ball on fifth stump, slapped through cover after a forward shuffle to pick up a single to the sweeper.
full on the stumps, flicked square through the ring to get off the mark.

Buttler with a sensational diving catch diving forward after charging in from long-off!  Length ball on the wide guideline, Prabhsimran tries to pull this to the leg side but it comes off the toe and pops up over mid-off. Buttler has 25+ yards to cover but never hesitates and makes it almost to the edge of the circle before launching himself forward and pulling off the catch at ankle height. 10/10 on the judge's scorecards by the panel from Russia, Brazili, New Zealand, Lesotho, Panama and Iceland.
full and angled into middle at 129 kph, jammed out through the leg side for one.
full and shuffles way outside off to flick this off eighth stump through midwicket for two.
full outside off, punched down the ground for one.
118 kph slower ball lands full on sixth stump, Shikhar charges before jamming this out to cover for none.
136 kph ball lands full on fifth stump, jammed out into the off side for none.
length ball follows Prabhsimran backing away from leg stump but he still punches inside out through cover for one.
135 kph delivery lands back of a length on off, tapped to extra cover for one.
slower ball at 119 kph lands full and angled into the pads, flicked through mid-on for one.
136 kph length ball sits up on fourth stump, now Prabhsimran takes a page out of the Aaron Judge playbook, going for a baseball style slug over centerfield into the sightscreen.
full on the stumps, driven over Chahal down the ground where Parag charges to his right from long-on and dives to save two runs.
good length ball dragged wide outside off after Shikhar telegraphs a charge, goes through with a heave across the line and a thick edge goes high and wide of Samson to the third man rope.
full and charges, drives to Chahal's left where he makes a diving stop.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.

short on fifth stump, slices a cut well behind point for two to bring up a maiden IPL fifty for Prabhsimran Singh. It comes off 28 balls after he was dropped on 44.  Muted applause from the Guwahati crowd, who are backing Rajasthan strongly.
full on the stumps, jammed out back to Chahal.
good length ball on off, flicked down the ground for one.
charges a full length ball and punched to long-off for one.
full outside off, driven down the ground for one.
length ball on off stump, backs away again to cut and bottom edges this into the ground before it bounces over the stumps past the keeper to fine leg for one.
good length ball on middle, Shikhar backs away to cut but picks out backward point.
full on off stump, flicked through mid-on for one.

dropped! Half-volley on seventh stump is pulverized to extra cover above head height. Padikkal reaches up but only manages to parry it over his head for one. It was 8/10 on difficulty, mainly due to the rapid pace that it was struck at toward the fielder at short distance, but it was essentially straight to him. Prabhsimran has been a menace in the Powerplay. How much will that missed chance cost Rajasthan?
back of a length on middle, pulled into midwicket for one.
short on the stumps, charges and smacks a front foot pull toward deep midwicket, stupendous one-handed stop by Jaiswal running left and fielding on one bounce to save a boundary.
full on fourth stump, flicked out to midwicket in the ring for none.
another slower ball this time lands full and very wide, carves a drive high over cover, one bounce over the rope.
starts with a slower wide bouncer on the guideline, can't get bat on this trying to stab it through the off side. Deemed legal inside the guideline.
full on fourth stump, digs it out to extra cover for none.
good length ball slanted in on sixth stump, cuts this fine to short third man on the ring fielded on a bounce for none.
good length ball on off, flicked to long-on for one.
length ball sliding down the leg side, misses a sweep and wide called.
full on eighth stump, lofts this elegantly over wide mid-off, one bounce over the rope.
full on fifth stump, slogs this across the line through midwicket and beats the leg side boundary rider to the rope.
full on middle, flicked over wide mid-on for one.
full on seventh stump, Prabhsimran charges like a rhino and gores this drive through extra cover to the rope.
bouncer wide outside off stump, beyond the guidelines outside off and out of reach of a cut, wide called.
fullish length on fifth stump, miscues a drive back to the bowler.
ka-pow! Length ball at 138 kph on off stump, sits up for Prabhsimran to play a short-arm jab pull over midwicket that sails 15 rows back.
length ball on fourth stump at 142 kph, cramped for room trying to cut but is still able to slice it behind point getting up onto his toes and beats deep third man to the rope.
bouncer at 144 kph on fourth stump, beats the attempted pull shot.
Djokovic would be proud! Length ball on fifth stump, comes down the track and tennis backhand swats this flat over mid-off to the rope.
back of a length on sixth stump, opens the face to guide this to deep third for one.
135 kph length ball on sixth stump, cuts this behind point and cut off at deep third man for one.
another back of a length ball on fourth stump, punched in front of point by Shikhar and a spectacular one-handed diving stop by Hetmyer at cover saves four runs.
141 kph delivery lands back of a length on fifth stump, punched elegantly square of the wicket through backward point to the rope again.
131 kph back of a length on off stump, goes back to flick through backward square leg to the rope.
back of a length on off, punched into the covers for none.
back of a length on off, defended back down the pitch.
hello! Off the facade of the third tier! Length ball on middle and leg, shuffles across to whip this high over backward square leg thudding into the railing of the upper deck stands.
119 kph slower length ball on seventh stump, Shikhar keeps the hands back long enough to slap this wide of mid-off for one.
full on fourth stump, driven firmly but a diving stop on the ring keeps it to none.
145 kph ball lands on a good length on off stump, punches at this and a thick edge goes square through backward point past Padikkal for two.
full and angled across fifth stump at 142 kph, beats him for pace driving.
135 kph delivery lands back of a length on off, defended back to Boult.
short on fifth stump, shuffles across to defend to point.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended.
full on seventh stump, shoveled on the up high over wide mid-off to the rope.
fullish length on the legs, flicked to backward square leg, diving stop by Hetmyer.
133 kph delivery back of a length tailing down the leg side, wide called. It squirts away from Samson to point Singh back on strike.
full and swinging in on fifth stump, punched wide of mid-off for one.
full and well outside leg, flicks this past short fine leg to the rope. Had he left it alone, it would have most likely been one wide, if not five had the keeper fumbled it....

full on fifth stump, shovels this tamely to long-off. The air pops out of the majority of the crowd. Kumar Sangakkara has a glum look in the Rajasthan dugout but Preity Zinta is beaming on the owner's balcony for Punjab.
low full toss on fifth stump, goes to reverse ramp this over third man but misses and they scamper an extra.

yorker is spot on fifth stump, jammed out to long-off for one. Hetmyer turns back for a suicide two, but Jurel didn't get the memo and stands pat for one. Hetmyer wanted the strike and winds up near the striker's end before giving up. The relay comes back to Curran, who takes the bails off disdainfully.
low full toss at shin height on seventh stump on an attempted yorker, sliced to wide extra cover sweeper and they charge back for a tight two.
full on the stumps, driven down the ground for one to long-on.

dropped! Rib high full toss on fourth stump, Hetmyer tries to heave this over deep midwicket and skies this a mile high. Ellis charges in from the rope and slides for a chance but it bursts through his hands. This looked like a blatant no ball over waist height live but Rajasthan are out of reviews, including an absurdly wasted one trying to turn a dot into a wide in the opening overs which flicked the pads.

missed runout! Good length ball on fourth stump, Jurel crouches and opens the face to guide this straight to short third man. The throw to the non-striker's end misses the stumps with Jurel four yards short but there was nobody covering the stumps to take the bails off.

Over or around the wicket makes no difference to Jurel! Another missed yorker, Arshdeep targets full on fifth stump, Jurel shuffles across to scoop this shin high full toss over the keeper. Harpreet runs across the rope trying to dive to stop it but can't do so.
Rajasthan not lying down one bit!  Half-volley on fourth stump, Arshdeep misses the yorker and it's in the slot to punch inside out over the rope screaming into the 10th row.
full on sixth stump, drives this flat over mid-off up in the ring and it sails one bounce over the rope.
full and speared down the leg side past a flick wide called.
yorker speared into middle stump, jammed out back to the bowler.
slower length ball on middle, Hetmyer keeps the hands back as long as he can before muscling a pull toward deep midwicket and it barely clears the fielder leaping on the rope.
shin high full toss on fourth stump, Jurel shuffles across and whips this through wide long-on for one.
short ball on the stumps, pulled flat over midwicket for one.
length ball on fifth stump, stands up and swats this flat through the gap between extra cover and wide mid-off to the rope.

waist high full toss, flicks this over deep fine leg and sails over the rope 12 rows back. Hetmyer looks to the square leg umpire for a no ball which isn't coming on field so he calls for a DRS review wanting a no ball.  It was right on the borderline. His body was twisting low as he played the shot and the third umpire says it was passing below the waist so stays as a legal delivery.
full on fifth stump, driven to the cover sweeper for one.
another slower ball yorker on middle, shuffles across to paddle this to short fine leg for one.
attempted slower ball yorker doesn't land and arrives at shin height on the legs, sweeps this flat over backward square leg thudding into the LCD ad boards for six.
low full toss on off stump, driven to long-off for one.
slower bouncer on middle, pulled along the turf to deep fine leg for one.
slower ball lands on a fullish length on the wide guideline, slogs this flat along the ground to long-on for one.
into the second tier over square leg! Full on the legs, winds up and launches this 96 meters over the leg side rope.
full on middle, flicked through square leg for one.
full outside leg, goes for a huge slog and misses losing his balance.
short on the stumps, cross-batted away for a single.

short outside leg stump, pulled to deep backward square leg where Harpreet Brar lets it bounce well short of him for one. The dropped chance by him off Buttler earlier may have been playing on his mind making no effort to charge in.
good length ball on the wide guideline, cut to backward point for a tight single made easy after he overruns the ball.
short on fourth stump, goes to pull and cue shots this wide of the non-striker dribbling to long-off for one.

bullseye! Ellis finally puts Padikkal out of his misery. Preity Zinta is up on her feet on the owner's balcony loving this with big applause. Length ball cross seam at full pace skids past a front foot pull and crashes into middle and off stump 3/4 of the way up.
slower ball lands back of a length on fifth stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length slower ball at 104 kph, Hetmyer through the shot early for a dot to the keeper.
back of a length on the hips, flicked through midwicket for two.
ooooooohhh not far off for Ellis. Good length ball on fourth stump skids past a forward prod.

full pace cross-seam delivery in the slot on fifth stump, Parag tries to launch this over long-off but skews it off the splice and it skies toward long-off. Shahrukh Khan comes in 20 yards off the rope and has to wait an eternity for the ball to come down before taking a simple catch.
length ball on fifth stump, again keeps a touch low skidding under a pull shot.
slower ball lands full on fourth stump, driven to long-on for one.
short and angled into the body, gets inside the line and just helps this on its way over fine leg, one bounce over the rope.
length ball angled across fifth stump, goes to pull and skids under the shot to the keeper.
131 kph short ball skids down the leg side past an attempted pull, no wide called as it hugged the imaginary line over leg stump.
back of a length on the pads, flicked through square leg for one.
fullish length ball on fifth stump, winds up and launches this a mile high and barely clears the rope at long-on.
full on sixth stump, slaughters a drive back to Raza off the pitch and he fields in front of his face for a dot.
full and wide, driven down the ground through mid-off for one.
well well well, miracles do happen. First boundary for Padikkal. Full and very wide, slices this off the toe high and swirls beyond the reach of short third before backspinning away to the rope.
full on middle, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
zings this in full on fifth stump, sliced to the cover sweeper for one.
short and wide, slaps this wide of the cover sweeper for two.
into the second deck over midwicket! Slightly short on the stumps, pulled high and deep over the leg side and sails 98 meters into the mezzanine.
good length ball on the legs, goes back to flick to midwicket and misses off the pads.
back of a length on the stumps, defended to midwicket.
good length ball on off stump, opens the face to guide this to short third for one.
full and wide, drives this high over extra cover for two.
full on fourth stump, tries to muscle this flat over long-off but picks out Matthew Short five yards inside the ring to take a catch at head height. Aussie tag team produces a wicket.
slower bouncer over leg stump, ducks under this and it is deemed legal on height.
full outside leg stump, goes to heave and inside edges this to fine leg for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, goes to cut this and is beaten cramped for room.
slower ball on a good length on fifth stump, slapped to extra cover for none.
full on middle, driven to long-off for one.
back of a length on the legs, chipped softly into midwicket for one.
shorter and wider, cuts to the sweeper for the right-hander for one.
short and wide, cut to the cover sweeper for one.
full on middle, heaved to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for two.
short and wide, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
low full toss on middle, flicked through deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on leg stump, tapped into vacant midwicket and chased down by Raza to keep it to one.
slings another one way down the leg side, no chance for the keeper to stop it and it goes to the fine leg rope for five wides.
full on off, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on fourth stump, driven to extra cover for none.
slings in a round-arm delivery down the leg side past a pull, wide called.
full and flicked away down the ground for one.
full and wide, sliced through the off side for one.
low full toss at shin height outside leg stump, flicked to wide long-on for one.
good length ball on leg stump, goes to flick through midwicket and a googly clips a leading edge to backward point for none.
full on middle, heaves this to deep midwicket along the ground for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, not much width but somehow still created enough room to sauté this behind point to the rope.
zipped in flat and full on leg stump, flicked to midwicket for one.
short on sixth stump and skids low, slapped to mid-off for none.
short and follows him outside leg, pulled to deep backward square leg for two.
good length ball on fifth stump, cuts this to backward point for none.
length ball slanted across the wide guideline, cuts this to the sweeper for one.
full on fourth stump, flicked to wide long-on for two, diving stop on the rope by Chahar saves two.
length ball on fifth stump, clears the front leg to cut and slices this to short third on a bounce for none.
back of a length on middle, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.

good length ball on the hips, passes down the leg side past a flick and given as a dot ball. Padikkal not happy and calls for a review claiming it should be a wide.  UltraEdge shows this clipped the thigh guard. Well, this has to go down as one of the all-time worst DRS reviews. Far more terrible than anything Shane Watson ever conjured up. It stays as a dot.
slower length ball on fourth stump, tapped defensively to backward point.

somewhat bizarre caught and bowled, but very athletic from Ellis! Good length ball on fourth stump, goes to drive straight and an inside edge comes off the pads and balloons up over short/silly mid-off. Ellis charges forward to corral a sliding take at knee height.
good length ball on the stumps, tapped gently into the ring for one.
length ball on fifth stump, slices this behind point and beats deep third man to the rope.
short and wide at 135 kph, gets on his toes and slaps this high over extra cover to the rope on two bounces.
good length ball skids on quicker on the stumps, defended to the off side.
good length on fifth stump, tap and run short of mid-off for one.
good length ball on the legs, goes to flick and misses off the pads.
length ball wide outside off, carved with much less drama over wide extra cover to the rope.

length ball on fourth stump, Samson leans back and swats this flat toward long-off, Shahrukh charges forward with a diving effort coming off the rope but he got nowhere near the ball, it short hops him by three yards and escapes past him to the rope. Subtle line between brave and foolish and that was the latter.
good length on fourth stump, defended.
half-volley on fifth stump, launches it halfway over the rope landing between the rope and the LCD ad boards.
length ball on fourth stump, pulled to deep square leg for one.
fullish length ball on fourth stump, Sanju winds up and wallops this high and deep over the bowler and it lands barely over the rope bouncing into the LCD ad boards in front of the sightscreen.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to cover for none.

the Ashwin experiment blows up, but not in the way that Rajasthan were hoping. Length ball on fifth stump, tries to pull this over mid-on but the ball climbs on him and produces a top-edge that floats in the air behind mid-on. Shikhar backpedals 10 yards before taking a catch at chest height.
low full toss on sixth stump, punched to extra cover for one.
back of a length on the legs, flicked through square leg for one.
back of a length on the hips, goes back to flick and misses off the body, dribbles wide of the stumps for a dot.
good length slower ball angled across fourth stump, beats Buttler prodding forward.
short on fifth stump, pulled much more authoritatively through midwicket to the rope.

dropped! Curran goes for the slower bouncer at 122 kph and Buttler struggles to keep the hands back flicking a pull toward Harpreet Brar charging in from the rope at deep square leg. He covers 20 yards and gets there in plenty enough time to reach forward in stride at rib height but shells this. It was 7/10 on difficulty due to the distance needed to cover but he got there upright without needing to dive and just fumbled it very clumsily.
length ball swatted square through the ring for two.
back of a length on fifth stump, pulls this flat into the ground to midwicket on the ring for none.
length ball outside off, goes to drive and is beaten.
length ball on seventh stump, stroked on the up through extra cover, sliding stop on the rope saves a run to keep it to three.

fullish length ball on sixth stump, drives loosely to extra cover. Basic catch taken at waist height. Fielder didn't have to move left or right. Matthew Short, on as a sub for Rajapaksa who was injured batting, takes the catch sliding forward on his haunches in front of his chest.
length ball slides well outside the off stump guideline, left alone and wide called.
slower length ball on seventh stump, goes to cut and misses.
length ball sliding down the leg side, wide called.
length ball on seventh stump, cuts this firmly behind point and goes to the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, goes to drive and misses.
length ball on fifth stump, slices a cut to deep backward point for one.
full on off stump, punched firmly to mid-off for none.
full on off, driven firmly to mid-on for none.
full on fifth stump, punched back down the pitch for none.
now that's a way to get the chase underway! Length ball on the hips, just flicks this effortlessly over square leg.
